description: Stabilization semantic parity corpus. Per fixture: canonical (bytecode VM) stdout/exit and the expected outcome per target. Outcomes: PASS, COMPILE_FAILURE (target rejected the program before running), RUNTIME_FAILURE (target failed closed while running), UNSUPPORTED (target does not implement the construct), NOT_RUN (runtime unavailable). A target outcome that differs from this table fails the test, so an unsupported target can never be silently counted as parity.
